source_horizon_basis: exp040 first_horizon=20M; fixed before inspecting the source curves
starting_time_rule: Exact maximum full-label standard ICL correct count over each new source monitor grid 0..20M, earliest checkpoint on ties; current peak-start convention

path_policy.user_instruction: 固定这个候选算法，即候选路径的数量无限制
path_policy.candidate_definition: Original adjacent-layer source Head to downstream label-K pathways
path_policy.candidate_pool: All pathways admitted by the original definition for the current model architecture

ranking.metric: Mean singleton cross-entropy gain over the original two protection data settings

path_policy.prefixes: Every ranked prefix k=1..N, where N is the actual full candidate count

coverage.definition: Minimum over protection data settings of mean set gain divided by mean full donor gain

path_policy.selection_rule: Smallest prefix reaching target; otherwise highest finite coverage, ties smaller k
path_policy.no_finite_coverage_rule: Retain existing choose_prefix fallback to the first ranked path and report the condition

mechanism_confirmation: Report only, never used to reselect; preserve structural and finite-state gates
data_policy: Reuse identical exp047 rebuilt features and fixed discovery/confirm/protection/monitor/evaluation pools; no encoding or data regeneration
source_identity: exp040 scientific kernels and exp047 shared utilities; seed IDs are the manuscript IDs
scope: Only current manuscript trajectories. Each protocol key, seed ID, output directory and saved-result ID uses the same manuscript ID.
